note: Targeted invalid site inventories, each the smallest document that carries the rule it breaks. Violations are (pointer, keyword) pairs only; a validator's free text is never recorded. The digests here are synthetic fixture data — no digest is recomputed over an invalid document.

input-digest-missing.proves: Both digests are mandatory: an inventory with no binding to the discovery input it was built from cannot be reproduced, so the member is required rather than optional.

output-digest-missing.proves: The output digest is mandatory too, so an inventory always states an identity for its own semantics that a sampling manifest can bind to.

content-digest-property.proves: D-PXAPI19-PO-004 fixes the digest topology at input and output. A third content_digest is refused by the closed root, so a second unowned notion of this document's identity cannot appear.

digest-not-algorithm-prefixed.proves: A digest carries its algorithm in the value. A bare hexadecimal string is refused, so no reader has to guess which algorithm produced it.

sitemap-state-property.proves: D-PXAPI19-PO-005: sources is the single authority on source state. A root-level sitemap_state would be a second account of the same fact, and the closed root refuses it.

robots-state-property.proves: The same rule for robots: no root-level parallel authority beside sources.

source-outcome-website-polarity.proves: A source outcome is a technical process state and never a website judgement. The vocabulary is closed, so a polarity token cannot be smuggled in as an outcome.

absent-source-claims-candidates.proves: A source that was never served cannot report having contributed pages. Every outcome under which admission was impossible is pinned to zero.

candidates-empty.proves: D-PXAPI19-PO-006: an apparently successful inventory with no candidate is not representable. An inventory exists only after a canonical origin was established, so it always holds at least the seed.

eligible-with-exclusion-reason.proves: An admissible candidate may not carry a reason it was excluded for; the two halves of the eligibility statement cannot contradict each other.

excluded-without-exclusion-reason.proves: An excluded candidate must name the technical reason, so an exclusion is never an unexplained verdict a reader could take for a defect of the page.

credential-bearing-url-key.proves: D-PXAPI19-PO-007: a credential-bearing URL never becomes persisted canonical contract data. The identity shape excludes userinfo outright.

anchor-label-property.proves: D-PXAPI19-PO-007: raw anchor labels are transient PXAPI-19.B input and are not part of this canonical contract. The closed candidate object refuses one.

score-property.proves: An inventory is not a score authority. No score, severity or grade member exists, and the closed root refuses one, so discovery cannot become a verdict.
